> Computational biologist and R programmer applying methods in data science to biomedical and translational research.

> Expertise of over 9 years in cancer genomics, transcriptomics, and next generation sequencing (NGS) data.

> Developing and adapting scalable [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/) pipelines for RNA-seq quantification and gene fusion analysis, as well as, somatic and structural variant analysis from long-read whole genome sequencing.
